shared: Vines hang on a host and grow when it grows, so you buff the host, often another tribe's.
differ: What vines copy: half of each gain, each gain in full, or half the biggest, once a turn.

takes.label: Trees of vines
takes.line: Climbers climb climbers, so one buff trickles at half down a whole chain; vines bigger than their host switch on fight powers.
takes.look_if: deep combo chains and several different ways to build.

takes.label: Rise and fall together
takes.line: Vines copy every host gain in full, can't be buffed any other way, and die with their host; big hubs hold several.
takes.look_if: a move-then-buff puzzle each turn with big swings.

takes.label: Back-row boosters
takes.line: Climbers sit in the three back slots and, each End of Turn, take half the biggest gain of the unit in front.
takes.look_if: a support tribe where back-row placement is the whole game.
